Co-Founder & CEO

Sagar Goswami

True growth is not about adding more, but about becoming more.

At Runr, we believe that creativity isn't just about content — it's about connecting people, emotions, and purpose.

This platform was born from a passion to reshape how brands speak, how creators express, and how audiences engage.

Our vision is not limited to trends — we’re here to set bold milestones, build meaningful collaborations, and challenge the ordinary. Every reel, every podcast, every campaign we create is a step towards a more expressive, authentic, and exciting digital future.

As the founder of Runr, I’m committed to nurturing talent, bringing fresh ideas to life, and building a brand that not only grows — but leads. Let’s keep pushing boundaries, together.
